mapper.select: SELECT TENANT_ID, OPERATION_NAME, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_HASH, REQUEST_HASH, BUSINESS_KEY, INSTANCE_ID, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM WF_IDEMPOTENCY WHERE DELETED=0 AND (1=0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WF_IDEMPOTENCY (TENANT_ID, OPERATION_NAME, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_HASH, REQUEST_HASH, BUSINESS_KEY, INSTANCE_ID, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{operationName}, #{idempotencyKeyHash}, #{requestHash}, #{businessKey}, NULL, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT REQUEST_HASH, INSTANCE_ID FROM WF_IDEMPOTENCY WHERE DELETED=0 AND (TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND OPERATION_NAME = #{operationName} AND IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_HASH = #{idempotencyKeyHash})
